build.buildCommand: NODE_ENV=development bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx turbo run build --filter=@acme/api...

deploy.startCommand: cd packages/api/.medusa/server && bunx medusa db:migrate && if [ "$SUBSHOP_BOOTSTRAP" = "true" ]; then bunx medusa exec ./src/scripts/seed-subshop.js; bunx medusa exec ./src/scripts/create-test-seller.js; bunx medusa user -e "$SUBSHOP_ADMIN_EMAIL" -p "$SUBSHOP_ADMIN_PASSWORD" || true; fi && bunx medusa start
